RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the May 16, 2007/Vaisakha 26, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
184
Incidence of cross-border  intrusion
†*581. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether incidence of cross-border
intrusions by foreign intruders in various
States of the country is on the decline;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the borders of the country which are
highly vulnerable to intrusions and the
reasons therefor; and
(d)  the details of measures taken by
Government to check intrusions?
Uniform criteria for DTH companies
and pay channels
*582. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
TRAI regulations for CAS, each consumer
must pay a maximum of Rs 5 for every
pay channel, while there is no such
stipulation for DTH, as the regulator
believes competition provides sufficient
price control;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are taking any
action to provide level playing field and
enforce uniform criteria for the DTH
companies to offer channels as per the
choice of viewers; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Camps for Sri Lankan refugees
*583.  DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the refugees who fled to
Indian refugee camps from Sri Lanka during
the recent encounter between LTTE and
the Sri Lankan Army in  Sri Lanka, are being
taken care of well by Indian Government
through the State;
(b) whether there have been any
instances recently of protest,
demonstrations and road roko by the Sri
Lankan refugees in Ramanathapuram
District in Tamil Nadu against the State
Government, alleging ill-treatment,
corruption, sex insults, etc.; and
(c) if so, the remedial measures taken
and whether they are adequate and
effective?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

185
State rural road development agency
*584. SHRIMATI  SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to make the State rural road development
agencies responsible for proper utilization of
funds sanctioned for rural roads under the
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana and
closely monitor the progress of work and
have regular review meetings with the
implementing agencies;
(b) whether till October, 2006 as many
as 57,444 road projects, worth Rs. 34,584.52
crores were sanctioned and Rs. 19,915.69
crores were released; and
(c) if so, what is the total number of
roads covered under this programme?
Cases of attack  on minorities
*585. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cases of
attack on minorities have been increasing
of late;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to contain the
same?
Commissioning of SEZs
*586. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many SEZs have been
commissioned so far;
(b) the SEZ-wise details of their export
earnings during the financial year 2006-07,
SEZ-wise;
(c) what was the export earning of the
non-IT SEZs out of this;
(d) what was the annual target for SEZs
for financial year 2006-07; and
(e) what is the export target for the
financial year 2007-08?
Safeguarding the interests of Indian
farmers in ASEAN
*587. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Association of South
East Asian Nations (ASEAN) had attended
to the sensitivities of India during the
negotiations held during January, 2007 in
Philippines, for the proposed Free Trade
Agreement (FTA);
(b) if so, whether India's objective of
forging a consensus with the ASEAN on
the contentious issues of the negative list
of items that we did not want to be
considered, was adequately achieved; and
(c) whether the interests of Indian
farmers and sections of the domestic
industry have been safeguarded?
Performance of Rural Development
Programmes
*588. SHRIMATI  VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the of Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
reviewed the implementation of the Rural
Development Programmes;
(b) if so, whether any shortcomings in
their implementation have been noticed in
Himachal Pradesh; and

Total number of questions — 155
1029
Space for weavers in SEZs
†4432. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether All India Handloom Board
has requested to reserve some space for
handloom and powerloom weavers in
Special Economic Zones;
(b) if so, whether their demand has been
accepted;
(c) whether any provision has been made
in Special Economic Zones for Vidarbha
region, which is leading in Handlooms and
Powerlooms; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Export of village produced goods
4433. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to push
exports of village produced goods, by grant
of deemed Export Promotion Council status
to the Village Industries Commission, to
ensure all-inclusive growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this initiative would create
employment for lakhs of women and the
rural poor; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Designating special products at Doha
Round
4434. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) which farm commodities would be
designated as Special Products in the ongoing
negotiations of the WTO's Doha Round;
and
(b) how would Government respond to
the United States insistence that Special
Products should be limited to "not more than
the tariff lines"?
Export target for 2007-08
4435. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set new
export target for 2007-08;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

1030
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof and the thrust
areas of export;
(c) whether giving exemption in
exporting agro produce and vegetables will
create shortage in the domestic market,
leading to upsurge in their prices; and
(d) if so, what action Government
contemplate to ensure their adequate
availability in domestic market?
Fewer ports for Export Promotion
Scheme
4436. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of 346
airports, seaports and inland depots in our
country, only 108 ports have been notified
for export promotion schemes; and
(b) if so, the details regarding the reasons
for not extending this scheme to all the
ports in the country, to save the freight
cost of large number of exporters?
Help to retailers by foreign companies
in retail sector
†4437. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether at the time of permitting
foreign direct investment in retail market in
the country any stipulation had been made
to the effect that foreign companies would
lend a helping hand in making retailers
financially sound;
(b) if so, in which areas the foreign
companies can extend help to retailers of
the country; and
(c) what effective provisions have been
made to ensure that retailers would not be
affected adversely due to entry of major
industrial houses in the retail business?
Assessment regarding expansion of
retail business
†4438. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per an
assessment a turnover of 30 billion dollars
during the next five years of retail business
in the country is expected;
(b) if not, the assessment of
Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that about
70 per cent share of total capital investment
in the said sector would be of major Indian
and foreign commercial institutions; if not,
Government's assessment in that regard; and
(d) what would be the share in capital
investment in total retail business of major
Indian and foreign companies, and Indian
small companies?
Uniformity in FDI
4439. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to bring
uniformity in the level of FDI within various
segments of a particular sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry is proposing to
increase the FDI limit in key areas in
telecom; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

1031
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
